comment: I LOVE Dr. Manganaro. He is my favorite professor at Richmond! He cares so deeply about each of his students, and really shows it. He effectively guides a discussion-based course -- which I loved because it meant I got to talk about my favorite parts of the books we were reading!! So accessible and helpful outside of class. Can't recommend enough!!

Manganaro is great at encouraging student discussion and he's very receptive to opinions that differ from his own. He can be a tough grader, but he's also super open to meeting with students and walking through their paper ideas with them. Would definitely take him again.

Boring class with a boring man. He doesn't seem to care a lot about his students and I just thought he was odd. Wouldn't take another class because there are definitely better teachers within the English Department.
grades harshly with minimal feedback. not very engaging. not enough notice for big assignments.

Dr. Manganaro is simply wonderful. Though five novels may seem daunting at first, TM is receptive to all student ideas and really allows the class to guide discussion. In terms of grading, he is extremely clear and concise in his expectations, which really position you for success for the larger writing assignments of the course. A very nice guy.

Prof. Manganaro is an acquired taste. Hes quirky and sometimes his jokes don't land but he has a good heart and really does care about what he teaches as well as his students. He was very understanding when I fell behind for medical reasons and helped me catch up. That being said, he does expect you to put in effort and will grade you accordingly.

I don't understand the other reviews of professor Manganaro. I came into this class reading the poor reviews expecting the worst semester of my life, but I thoroughly enjoyed his class. I hate english and took this as a gen ed. Every class is a giant discussion on the reading that was due. There are several two page analysis papers, and 3 essays.

I've taken several classes with Thomas. He expects a lot from his students, but as long as you participate he leads THE BEST discussions. Talk to him about your papers beforehand and then follow his advice. He's firm in class but kind and understanding alone

TM is the worst professor I have taken in this department. He seems uninterested in genuine student ideas and steers all discussion back to his own opinions. His paper prompts are dull and he grades harshly-- his feedback is unhelpful and sometimes even vaguely rude. He doesn't seem to care about getting to know his students either.
